# cellgeni/irods/getfile

## Summary

Downloads a file from iRODS to the local working directory and verifies its integrity
by comparing the local MD5 checksum against the iRODS-recorded checksum. The process
exits with an error if the file does not exist on iRODS or if the checksums do not match.

## Inputs

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `meta.id` | string | Sample identifier. |
| `irodsfile` | string | Full iRODS path to the file to download (e.g. `/seq/illumina/runs/12345/12345_1#1.cram`). |

## Outputs

| Name | File(s) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | `*` | The downloaded file in the task working directory. |
| `versions` | `versions.yml` | YAML file recording the versions of iRODS iCommands, awk, and md5sum. |

## Usage

```nextflow
include { IRODS_GETFILE } from 'cellgeni/irods/getfile'

IRODS_GETFILE(
    channel.of([[id: 'sample1'], '/seq/illumina/runs/12345/12345_1#1.cram'])
)
```

## License

MIT

/*
 * Module: cellgeni/irods/getfile
 */

process IRODS_GETFILE {
    tag "${meta.id}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), val(irodsfile)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${irodsfile.tokenize('/')[-1]}"), emit: file
    path 'versions.yml'                                    , emit: versions

    script:
    def args =task.ext.args ?: '-f -v -K -X restartfile.txt --retries 5'
    """
    # check if the file exists on iRODS and note a collection
    if ils ${irodsfile} 2>&1 | grep -q 'No such file or collection' ; then
        echo "File ${irodsfile} does not exist on iRODS"
        exit 1
    fi

    # get the file from iRODS
    iget ${args} ${irodsfile}

    # calculate the md5 checksum of the downloaded file
    localmd5=\$(md5sum ${irodsfile.tokenize('/')[-1]} | awk '{print \$1}')
    irodsmd5=\$(ichksum "${irodsfile}" | awk '{print \$NF}')

    # compare the checksums
    if [ "\$localmd5" != "\$irodsmd5" ]; then
        echo "MD5 checksum mismatch for ${irodsfile}"
        echo "Local MD5: \$localmd5"
        echo "iRODS MD5: \$irodsmd5"
        exit 1
    fi

    cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml
    "${task.process}":
        irods: \$(ienv | grep version | awk '{ print \$3 }')
        awk: \$(awk --version | head -n1)
        md5sum: \$(md5sum --version | head -n1 | awk '{ print \$4 }')
    END_VERSIONS
    """

    stub:
    """
    touch ${irodsfile.tokenize('/')[-1]}
    cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml
    "${task.process}":
        irods: \$(ienv | grep version | awk '{ print \$3 }')
        awk: \$(awk --version | head -n1)
        md5sum: \$(md5sum --version | head -n1 | awk '{ print \$4 }')
    END_VERSIONS
    """
}

---
name: "cellgeni/irods/getfile"
description: >
  Downloads a file from iRODS to the local working directory and verifies its integrity
  by comparing the local MD5 checksum against the iRODS-recorded checksum.
keywords:
  - iRODS
  - download
  - checksum
  - md5
tools:
  - iget:
      description: "Downloads a data object from iRODS to the local filesystem."
      homepage: "https://docs.irods.org/master/icommands/user/#iget"
      licence:
        - "BSD-3-Clause"
  - ichksum:
      description: "Computes and retrieves the checksum of an iRODS data object."
      homepage: "https://docs.irods.org/master/icommands/user/#ichksum"
      licence:
        - "BSD-3-Clause"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Map with sample-level metadata. Must contain key 'id'.\ne.g. [ id:'sample1' ]\n"
  - irodsfile:
      type: "string"
      description: "Full iRODS path to the file to download (e.g. '/seq/illumina/runs/12345/12345_1#1.cram')."
output:
  file:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Map with sample-level metadata, passed through from input.\ne.g. [ id:'sample1' ]\n"
    - "*":
        type: "file"
        description: "The downloaded file, placed in the task working directory."
  versions:
  - path: "versions.yml"
    type: "file"
    description: "YAML file recording the versions of iRODS iCommands, awk, and md5sum used by this process."
authors:
  - "@claptar"
maintainers:
  - "@claptar"
version: "0.0.1"
license: "MIT"
